about: Labels for make watch-replay: for each NVIDIA filing of the twelve months to 18 Nov 2026, does it bear on a claim of the thesis below, and on which. Written by the agent that built the watch (Claude Opus 5.5) from `make watch-replay ARGS="--list --since 2025-11-18"` (form, date, items and each item's opening sentences), BEFORE triage was run on any of them, and committed before the first replay. 'Bears' means: an owner of this thesis would want to look at it again because of this filing. Never change a label to match a result; if a label is wrong, say so in the replay's write-up and leave the file as it was.

thesis.name: NVIDIA: leadership, data centre growth, balance sheet
thesis.decision: Whether to keep holding NVIDIA shares through the next year
claims: Jensen Huang's leadership as chief executive is a key reason to own NVIDIA.
Data center revenue keeps growing faster than the rest of the business.
NVIDIA's balance sheet is strong, with little debt.
NVIDIA grows by acquiring software and platform companies.

labels.why: Quarterly results announced: revenue mix and margins.
Quarterly report: segment revenue, debt, margins.
A director (Persis Drell) resigned from the board; not the chief executive, and no claim is about the board.
Annual report: segment revenue, debt, margins.
A variable compensation plan for officers adopted; no officer comes or goes.
The chief accounting officer retires and is replaced; not the chief executive.
A new director appointed; no claim is about the board.
About $25 billion of new notes issued: directly against 'little debt'.
The head of worldwide field operations retires and is succeeded; not the chief executive.
Residual value guarantees for a data centre campus: a new off-balance-sheet obligation (Item 2.03). A partnership, not an acquisition, so not c4.
Agreement to acquire Hugging Face for about $11.9 billion: a platform acquisition, paid for from the balance sheet.
Jen-Hsun Huang resigned as chief executive; an interim CEO named.
